text: Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority to appoint and remove directors from the boards of Businesses Improvement Areas (BIAs) that fall within its geographic boundaries. The purpose of this report is to remove one director who has resigned from the Lakeshore Village BIA Board of Management.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Removed the following director from the Lakeshore Village Business Improvement Area Board of Management set out below: Salima Virani
